Using the \(\sigma_z\) basis,

\[
|\psi\rangle=\begin{pmatrix}1/2\\ \sqrt3/2\end{pmatrix},
\qquad 
\sigma_z=\begin{pmatrix}1&0\\0&-1\end{pmatrix},
\qquad
\sigma_x=\begin{pmatrix}0&1\\1&0\end{pmatrix}.
\]

The state is normalized since \((1/2)^2+(\sqrt3/2)^2=1\). Also,

\[
\langle \sigma_z\rangle=\frac14-\frac34=-\frac12,
\]

and, because the relative phase is real and positive,

\[
\langle \sigma_x\rangle=2\left(\frac12\right)\left(\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\right)=\frac{\sqrt3}{2}.
\]

Therefore,

\[
\langle 10\sigma_z+5\sigma_x\rangle
=10\left(-\frac12\right)+5\left(\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\right)
=\frac{5}{2}(\sqrt3-2)\approx -0.6699\approx -0.7.
\]

Answer: A
